description: Trastuzumab deruxtecan is recommended for use within the Cancer Drugs Fund as an option for treating HER2-positive unresectable or metastatic breast cancer in adults after 1 or more anti-HER2-based regimens. It is recommended only if the conditions in the managed access agreement are followed.
